ConceptDef.label: Cultivation
ConceptDef.helpText:
Since the Convergence, qi flows again. Colonists with a SPIRIT ROOT can gather it.

Select a colonist and open the CULTIVATION tab: root, realm, stage, qi and what the realm grants.

To cultivate is to MEDITATE: give the colonist hours of Meditate in the Schedule tab (or let them meditate for recreation). Every breath taken in meditation gathers qi and fills the realm's progress bar, faster on a meditation spot, cushion or platform and where the qi is thick. Stage by stage, the colonist reaches a bottleneck.

Colonists without a root can still TEMPER THE BODY: eat spirit-beast meat and train.

ConceptDef.label: Cultivation techniques
ConceptDef.helpText:
Each new stage gives comprehension points; each realm gives more.

Spend them with the TECHNIQUES command of the colonist, or the TECHNIQUES AND DEVELOPMENT button at the top of the Cultivation tab. Unlock paths (one per element of the root, plus martial arts) and learn techniques.

Drag active techniques into a COMBAT SET: those are the abilities the colonist shows when drafted. Jade slips and manuals open more paths.

ConceptDef.label: Bottlenecks and tribulation
ConceptDef.helpText:
At the last stage of a realm the cultivator hits a BOTTLENECK: progress stops.

The BREAKTHROUGH command appears on the colonist (only when not drafted). Requirements are listed on the button. Pills and a solid foundation help.

Breaking into a great realm calls down a HEAVENLY TRIBULATION. Implants add celestial dissonance and make it harsher.

ConceptDef.label: Qi network
ConceptDef.helpText:
Formations and qi buildings work like power: GENERATORS feed the network, CONDUITS carry it, and consumers draw it.

The first generators burn spirit stones. Later ones draw qi from the air, from storms or from veins under the ground.

The QI OVERLAY button (bottom right, next to the other map overlays) shows where qi gathers. Build on bright ground.
